## prompt-1-mermaid

*Generated by Process A (the bootstrap milestone) from the single master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-ind.md`](../prompts/prompt-ind.md), adapting the
`trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-1-mermaid.md` and
`trial-documents/sub-prompts` conventions to the Phase 1 PDAC IND build. Runs in
stage `trial-ind/mermaid/`.*

Author the **Stage 1 grayscale Mermaid figure catalog** for *Phase 1 PDAC IND: AI
Generation* (Draft 1.0, repository v4.3.0) into `trial-ind/mermaid/`.

**Scope.** Produce at least **20** new, comprehensive, professional Mermaid
diagrams, each in its own Markdown file (`fig-NN-slug.md`) that opens with a real
```` ```mermaid ```` fenced block so it renders natively on GitHub, followed by a
short caption, the figure's role in the IND, and the exact `physical-ai-oncology-trials`
source files the figure draws from (Rule 5). Every figure must be **new to this
IND** - do not re-use any prior author figure from `trial-protocol`,
`trial-documents`, or elsewhere. There must be **no overlap between components**
within any figure. All quantitative content (dose levels, force caps, vessel
zones, advisory windows, sample size, time-saved days/weeks, CI bounds) must be
carried verbatim from the author sources so each diagram is comprehensive, not
decorative.

**Grayscale palette (Rule: grayscale figures; keep template color = black body).**
The figures are strictly grayscale. Map every node to one of eight tones via a
`classDef` that corresponds 1:1 to the LaTeX `indstyle.sty` `mm*` node styles:

| Role | `classDef` | Fill | Text |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| End goal, decision, outcome | `goal` | `#000000` | white |
| LLM / process / system | `proc` | `#3F3F3F` | white |
| Acceleration / emphasis | `accent` | `#6C757D` | white |
| Secondary process | `step` | `#9AA0A6` | black |
| Input / source file | `input` | `#ECECEC` | black |
| Context / support | `ctx` | `#F5F5F5` | black |
| Decision / gate (diamond) | `dec` | `#D9D9D9` | black |
| Rules / raw data / audit | `dark` | `#222222` | white |

Init directive: `%%{init: {'theme':'base','themeVariables':{'fontSize':'12px','lineColor':'#6C757D'}}}%%`.

**Required figure families (22 figures).** The figures blend two perspectives -
the IND-acceleration document process (adapted in context, not copied, from
`trial-documents/final-paper/publication` Figures 6, 9, 11, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20,
23, 24) and the IND clinical/regulatory content (from
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication`):

1. IND single-prompt build pipeline (mermaid -> draft -> full -> final, real-time auto-commit / auto-PR).
2. ReGARDD IND Table-of-Contents architecture (11 sections mapped to `sec-*.tex`).
3. Cover Letter plus FDA Form 1571 and 3674 cover-sheet flow (serial 0000; 3674 Box A / B / C).
4. The six greatest-acceleration IND document targets (adapt Fig 16; IND + IRB package ranked first).
5. Composition of the initial IND and IRB package (adapt Fig 17; 30-day FDA clock).
6. Phase 1 IND document landscape before / during / after submission (adapt Fig 6).
7. Pre-submission IND authoring workflow (adapt Fig 9; PI + biostat + template -> writers -> modules -> clock).
8. The three timeline buckets with exact time saved per IND document (adapt Fig 19; state days / weeks).
9. Five name-matching and grounding verifications for the IND (adapt Fig 20; IND examples).
10. The patient time-saved cascade from a faster IND (adapt Fig 24; faster IND -> earlier first dose -> PFS / OS).
11. Figure grounding: each Mermaid source reproduced as an identical TikZ figure (adapt Fig 15; verify twice).
12. The real-world daraxonrasib PDAC document thread (adapt Fig 23; IND -> cohort review -> amendments -> Phase 2).
13. Post-submission IND maintenance authoring (adapt Fig 11; safety reports, DSUR, amendments, synchronized consent).
14. Daraxonrasib mechanism and pharmacological class (RAS(ON) multi-selective, GTP-bound KRAS, cyclophilin A).
15. The 3+3 dose-escalation decision automaton (DL1 160 / DL2 220 / DL3 300 mg; escalate / expand / MTD / RP2D).
16. CMC information architecture (drug substance, drug product, placebo, labeling, environmental assessment).
17. Pharmacology and toxicology integrated-summary structure (pharmacology summary, integrated tox, full data tabulation).
18. Perioperative daraxonrasib pause-and-restart advisory (ISGPS grade plus serum 0.5 ng/mL -> T+7 / T+14 / T+21; sweep 29 / 3 / 0).
19. Safety-reporting clocks (7-day / 15-day) plus the six Physical AI reporting triggers (§312.32(g)).
20. Study governance and three-tier oversight (DSMB, ISM, Physical AI Safety Review Committee) plus halt rules.
21. General Investigational Plan: three co-primary objectives mapped to endpoints plus the first-year plan.
22. Previous Human Experience evidence base (RASolute 302, RASolve 301, Breakthrough Therapy, five computational works).

**Commit schedule (Rule 6, 7, 8).** One commit per figure file (22), pushed to
GitHub the moment it is generated. The second-to-last commit fixes all errors
across the figure files. The last commit writes `README.md` (the figure
inventory with named source files) and `output-mermaid.md`. No `png` or `jpg`
files (Rule 3). Single dashes only; `§` for codified references.
